2,339 likes, 21 comments - kayla_itsines on October 25, 2026: "This one’s all core, and it BURNS 🔥
Send this to your workout partner👇🏽

Alternating Toe Tap | 10 Reps Per Side
Side Plank & Oblique Crunch | 10 Reps Per Side
Straight Leg Raises | 12 Reps
Plank Hip Dips | 10 Reps Per Side
Bent Leg Sit Up | 15 Reps
Plank Rotation | 8 Reps Per Side
Mountain Climbers | 30 Reps

Complete 3 rounds.

Tip: Drop to your knees on the planks whenever you need to... modified still counts!".
